summary: OpenAI is converting its GPT-5.5 Bio Bug Bounty into an ongoing private Bio Bounty Program targeting universal jailbreaks against biosafety safeguards in its frontier models starting with GPT-5.6, and raising the reward for a successful jailbreak from $25,000 to $50,000.

practices.reason: Describes an internal red-teaming/bug-bounty structure for biosafety jailbreaks, but it is OpenAI's own private, NDA-gated program rather than a transferable methodology.
practices.quote: The program will remain focused on universal jailbreaks that can defeat our predefined biosafety challenge against OpenAI’s frontier models, starting with GPT‑5.6 and going forward.
